PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, MARCH 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  FINISHED AGENDA & DRAFT MINUTES

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 9:00 AM, President Scott called the meeting to order.

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Tai Tseng, Assistant General Manager, Utilities Department, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott

 CONSENT CALENDAR

 A motion was made by Commissioner Maguire, seconded by Commissioner Austin, to
 approve Consent Calendar Item 1. The motion carried by the following vote:

 Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
 No:  0  None
 Recused:  0  None
 Abstain:  0  None
 Absent:  0  None

 1.  26-54486  Recommendation to approve February 19, 2026 Board meeting minutes.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Maguire, seconded by Commissioner
  Austin, to approve recommendation on the Consent Calendar. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  Page 1 of 5
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, MARCH 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Absent:  0 None

REGULAR AGENDA

2.  26-54488  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend the existing contract with Bradley Tanks, Inc. for excavation
  material hauling and disposal services by increasing the authorized annual amount
  for the renewal terms by $350,000, for a revised amount not to exceed $1,527,000
  for the first renewal term; a revised amount not to exceed $1,633,890 for the
  second renewal term; and a revised total aggregate agreement amount not to
  exceed $4,260,890.

  A motion was made by Vice President Cordero, seconded by Commissioner
  Maguire, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  26-54489  Recommendation to Grant the request of Environmental Construction, Inc.
  pursuant to Public Contract Code Section 5101, to be relieved of their bid as set
  forth in their letter dated February 6, 2026, requesting withdrawal of their bid due to
  clerical errors; and

  Adopt Specifications WD-08-25 for the Removal of Water Well Annex 26 Project
  (EO-3744), award a contract to Levon Construction Group in a total contract
  amount not to exceed $580,000 for a period of one year, and authorize the
  General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract,
  including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  A motion was made by Secretary Parkin, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Danna Monzon, Manager of Engineering, Utilities Department, provided the staff
  report.

  Page 2 of 5
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, MARCH 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Secretary Parkin spoke.

  Danna Monzon, Manager of Engineering, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Secretary Parkin spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Secretary Parkin and Danna Monzon, Manager of
  Engineering, Utilities Department.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Secretary Parkin spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Secretary Parkin and Anatole Falagan, General
  Manager, Utilities Department.

4.  26-54490  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into an agreement, including any necessary subsequent
  amendments, with the State of California, Department of Community Services and
  Development (CSD), to provide direct credit of allocated federal Low-Income Home
  Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) funds to the Long Beach Public Utilities
  Department on behalf of qualifying low-income gas utility customers for a three-
  year period from April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2029.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Secretary Parkin,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Tony Foster, Senior Director of Business Services, Utilities Department, provided
  the staff report.

  Vice President Cordero spoke.

  Tony Foster, Senior Director of Business Services, Utilities Department, spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Vice President Cordero and Tony Foster, Senior
  Director of Business Services, Utilities Department.

  Secretary Parkin spoke.

  Page 3 of 5

  THURSDAY, MARCH 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Tony Foster, Senior Director of Business Services, Utilities Department, spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Secretary Parkin and Tony Foster, Senior Director of
  Business Services, Utilities Department.

  Vice President Cordero spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Vice President Cordero and Tony Foster, Senior
  Director of Business Services, Utilities Department.

  Commissioner Austin spoke.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

  Secretary Parkin spoke.

  Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilities Department, spoke.

  A dialogue ensued between Secretary Parkin and Anatole Falagan, General
  Manager, Utilities Department.

5.  26-54491  Recommendation to receive and file the February 19, 2026 Resources Committee
  Report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Austin, seconded by Vice President
  Cordero, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  5  Austin, Maguire, Parkin, Cordero, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Vice President Cordero provided a verbal report.

  Commissioner Austin spoke.

  Vice President Cordero spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There were no comments received from the public.

  Page 4 of 5
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, MARCH 5, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Anatole Falagan, General Manager, Utilties Department, spoke.

Vice President Cordero spoke.

President Scott spoke.

ADJOURNMENT

At 9:31 AM, President Scott adjourned the meeting.

NOTE:

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
persons is desired, please make your request by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-
6101, 72 business hours prior to the Commission meeting.

Kung nais ang pagsasalin ng nakasulat na wika ng agenda ng Komisyon at ang minutes para sa
mga taong hindi nagsasalita ng Ingles, mangyaring isagawa ang iyong hiling sa pamamagitan ng
telepono sa Opisina ng Clerk ng Lungsod sa (562) 570-6101, 72 oras ng negosyo bago ang
pagpupulong ng Commission.

Si desea obtener la traducción escrita en otro idioma de la agenda y actas de la comisión para
personas que no hablan inglés, haga su solicitud por teléfono a la Oficina de la Secretaría Municipal
al (562) 570-6101, 72 horas hábiles antes de la reunión de la comisión.
